disclaimer: Anti-cheat systems and native-Mac availability change over time. Every entry records when it was last reviewed and where the claim comes from. EasyPlay never invents a rating: a game with no known blocker is reported as untested, not as working.

entries.title: VALORANT
entries.source: Riot Vanguard is publicly documented as a kernel driver
notes: Riot has stated Vanguard will not support emulation or virtualisation.

entries.title: League of Legends
entries.source: Riot Vanguard is publicly documented as a kernel driver
notes: Riot ships an official macOS client - use that rather than Wine.

entries.title: Fortnite
entries.source: Epic publicly documents Easy Anti-Cheat on Fortnite
notes: Epic withdrew macOS support for Battle Royale in 2020.

entries.title: Apex Legends
entries.source: EA publicly documents Easy Anti-Cheat on Apex Legends
notes: EA ended Steam Deck and Linux support in 2024 over anti-cheat.

entries.title: Destiny 2
entries.source: Bungie publicly documents BattlEye on Destiny 2
notes: Bungie has stated that playing via emulation risks a ban.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege
entries.source: Ubisoft publicly documents BattlEye on Siege

entries.title: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS
entries.source: KRAFTON publicly documents BattlEye on PUBG

entries.title: ELDEN RING
entries.source: FromSoftware ships Easy Anti-Cheat with ELDEN RING
notes: It runs on Steam Deck because Easy Anti-Cheat has an opt-in Proton mode for Linux. That support does not extend to macOS Wine.
Some players disable EAC for offline play; that breaks multiplayer and EasyPlay will not automate it.

entries.title: Rust
entries.source: Facepunch publicly documents Easy Anti-Cheat on Rust
notes: Facepunch dropped its macOS build in 2021.

entries.title: Escape from Tarkov
entries.source: Battlestate publicly documents BattlEye on Tarkov

entries.title: Call of Duty
entries.source: Activision publicly documents RICOCHET as a kernel-level driver
notes: Applies to the modern Call of Duty titles and Warzone.

entries.title: Genshin Impact
entries.source: The Windows client installs a kernel-level anti-cheat driver
notes: There are official iOS and Android builds; there is no macOS client.

entries.title: Forza Horizon 5
entries.source: Playground Games ships Easy Anti-Cheat with Forza Horizon 5

entries.title: Baldur's Gate 3
entries.source: Larian ships an official macOS build
notes: Buy the Mac version - it runs natively and will outperform anything Wine can do.

entries.title: Cyberpunk 2077
entries.source: CD PROJEKT RED ships an Apple Silicon macOS build
notes: The Mac version is native to Apple Silicon - no need for EasyPlay.

entries.title: Hades
entries.source: Supergiant ships an official macOS build

entries.title: Stardew Valley
entries.source: ConcernedApe ships an official macOS build

entries.title: No Man's Sky
entries.source: Hello Games ships an Apple Silicon macOS build

entries.title: Death Stranding Director's Cut
entries.source: Kojima Productions ships an Apple Silicon macOS build

entries.title: Resident Evil Village
entries.source: Capcom ships an Apple Silicon macOS build

entries.title: Sid Meier's Civilization VI
entries.source: Aspyr ships an official macOS build

entries.title: Disco Elysium: The Final Cut
entries.source: ZA/UM ships an official macOS build

entries.title: Hollow Knight
entries.source: Team Cherry ships an official macOS build

entries.title: Celeste
entries.source: Maddy Makes Games ships an official macOS build

entries.title: Divinity: Original Sin 2
entries.source: Larian ships an official macOS build

entries.title: RIDE 4
entries.source: CodeWeavers CrossOver compatibility database
notes: EasyPlay ships a preset for this game.
The rating comes from CrossOver's database and has not been re-verified locally.

entries.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
entries.source: No known blocker; not verified by EasyPlay
notes: Single-player, no anti-cheat, 64-bit DirectX 11 - the combination most likely to work.

entries.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
entries.source: No known blocker; not verified by EasyPlay
notes: Single-player, no anti-cheat, 64-bit DirectX 11.

entries.title: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
entries.source: No known blocker; not verified by EasyPlay
notes: Single-player only, and unlike ELDEN RING it ships no Easy Anti-Cheat.

entries.title: Counter-Strike 2
entries.source: VAC is not kernel-level; not verified by EasyPlay
notes: Valve dropped the macOS build with Counter-Strike 2.
VAC does not block Wine the way kernel anti-cheat does, but Valve may still act on unusual clients.

entries.title: Hogwarts Legacy
entries.source: No kernel anti-cheat; not verified by EasyPlay
notes: Denuvo copy protection sometimes misbehaves under Wine.
DirectX 12 is less well covered than DirectX 11 on Apple Silicon.

entries.title: Monster Hunter: World
entries.source: No known blocker; not verified by EasyPlay

entries.title: Control
entries.source: No known blocker; not verified by EasyPlay
